That's awful!
Is it...?

＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿００３But... if she collapses, it￥causes trouble for everyone...＝＠１４５＿００４She's more stubborn than she￥looks. Tell her to rest, and she￥won't listen.＝＠１４５＿００５The best thing is for her to get￥better soon.
Hence the harsh words...
Hope she gets well soon.
So that's how you felt.
Hope she gets well soon.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿００６Unless I say it like that,￥she never listens.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿００７Yeah, me too.

＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１０Sorry for putting you through￥all this trouble.
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１１And... don't tell Sakaki about￥the mistake in the simulator￥settings, okay?
＊Narusawa＊＠１４５＿０１２Well then, head back for today￥and get some good rest.
